data.street_address: Cabot Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 4QT

description.text:
Relax, roll up your sleeves and get stuck in the Nando's way! The flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken is legendary. Cooked to order in a choice of spicy bastes ranging from the mild Lemon & Herb to the tongue-scorching Extra Hot, there's a style to suit all tastes. A quick lunch, a family party, an evening with friends - whatever - Nando's menu, brimming with tasty appetisers, side dishes, salads and desserts, is the business. Bottomless soft drinks are fun for kids and the sharing platters are excellent value. Add beers and quality wines galore and the picture's complete. For a unique flavour in cool surroundings, visit Nando's!

Office Delivery / Collection Service

- Order to collect in store via www.takeaway.nandos.co.uk
- Order for delivery by emailing canarywharf.cabotplace@nandos.co.uk by 5pm the day before the order is required for delivery by 12pm at the latest or earlier if required. Minimum spend for delivery �50. Orders to be paid by cash or card in the restaurant on the day or earlier in the week. Deliveries up until 12pm and after 2.30pm 7 days a week.

Location: Cabot Place
